children.name: Evidence
children.value: The SV7 header's encoder version at 0x1B is 116, as encodes with mppenc 1.16 (built from source) write it

findings.message: The header gives 1500 samples for the last frame, more than a frame's 1152; libmpcdec refuses the stream.
The 11 bits after the last frame give 486 samples, the header 1500; with true gapless, libmpcdec takes the bits after the frame, and so does the analyzer.
